name: Mortgage Brokers
extra_prompt: You are booking for a mortgage broker. Ask about the loan purpose, property type, deposit, income type (PAYG or self-employed), and timeline. Ask about existing loans and whether it is an auction purchase. Do not give credit advice in the booking flow. Quote fees only from the reference answers, and say final costs depend on lender and approval. Do not promise a loan approval or specific rate.

kb.a: {price_note} Our fee structure is [your fee structure], and we explain any lender or broker fee in writing before you proceed.
Yes, we arrange loan pre-approvals. For auctions, allow [number] business days for the pre-approval to come through.
It depends on your income, debts, and deposit. We will run a borrowing estimate with you before you apply.
Yes, we help with refinances, including rate reductions and cash-out options where lenders offer them. We compare your current loan with options from our lenders.
Yes, we help self-employed borrowers, including low-doc and alt-doc options where lenders offer them. You will usually need recent tax returns or notices of assessment.
Yes, we arrange investment property loans, including interest-only options where lenders offer them. Tell us about your current property holdings when you call.
Yes, we arrange commercial loans and asset finance. Commercial lending often needs more documents, which we will confirm with you.
Yes, we arrange construction loans, which are often paid in progress payments as work is completed. Tell us your build timeline and builder details.
Yes, we arrange SMSF loans for eligible borrowers and properties. Eligibility depends on your fund's structure, so we check it with you first.
Yes, we can consolidate credit cards and personal loans into a home loan where suitable. We check whether it saves you money before you commit.
ID, payslips, bank statements, and existing loan statements. Self-employed clients need tax returns and notices of assessment.
Approval time depends on the lender and how complete your documents are. We will tell you the expected timeframe for your application.

kb.q: Do you charge for a rate review?
kb.a: {rate_review_note} We confirm any rate review fee in writing before we start.
We operate under [your Australian Credit Licence number] or as a credit representative of [licensee name]. You can check these details on the ASIC register before you apply.

kb.q: Do you work with all lenders?
kb.a: We work with a panel of [number] lenders. Tell us your needs and we will match you with lenders on our panel.

kb.q: Do you do car and personal loans?
kb.a: Yes, we arrange car, personal, and equipment finance. Tell us the loan amount and purpose so we can compare options.
